statement: Linse designs, builds, publishes and runs technology for businesses and institutions in Rwanda and the region.
Six services under one roof: design, websites and apps, systems and integration, the software we publish, hardware and distribution, and IT services.
One team carries a project from the first sketch to the device on the desk, and stays to keep it running.

breakthrough.title: One partner, end to end
breakthrough.blurb: One team designs, builds, supplies and supports your technology, so nothing falls between suppliers.
body: Most organisations run their technology through a patchwork: an agency for the website, a developer for the system, a shop for the laptops, someone else for the network. Every hand-over is a place where things slip, and nobody owns the whole.

With Linse, the same team designs the product, writes the software, supplies and installs the devices, and keeps everything running afterwards. One contract, one point of contact, one team that knows how the pieces fit together.
That is what everything IT under one roof means for a client: fewer suppliers, faster decisions, and a single partner accountable from the first sketch to the help-desk call.

transformation.title: Six services, one team
transformation.blurb: Each service stands on its own. Together they cover everything a business needs from its technology.
body: The people who design your app also build it; the team that installs your network also monitors it; the software we publish runs on the same infrastructure we manage for clients.
Here is what each service covers:

supercycle.title: Technology that keeps running
supercycle.blurb: Most of the value of technology comes after launch.
body: A website, a system or an office network is only useful while it works. Our IT services team runs what we build and what you already have: help desk, networks, cloud, backups and security, under one contract with agreed response times.

We monitor around the clock, fix issues before they spread and report every month on what was done. When a critical issue needs someone on site in Kigali, a technician is working on it within the hour.

quote.text: Launch day is the easy part. What our clients really buy is every ordinary day after it: systems that are watched, patched and fixed before anyone notices, by people who know their setup by name.
